SCE.S:5B5854: My high school girlfriend, met again after 12 years. Married after I left the City; single now.
SCE.S:5B59EC: Patrol cop for New Town. His beat rarely sees real crime, so he's not used to cases.
SCE.S:5B5AB8: Watching patients deform, something in her broke. She came to work with her father's hunting rifle.
SCE.S:5B5B84: In for his appendix. On a stroll he met a man with a giant head and fled to a toilet.
SCE.S:5B5C50: Grandson of a famed germ expert; now he hunts the cause of the strange disease.
SCE.S:5B5DE8: Actually an orthopedic surgeon. Level-headed; stays calm even in a crisis.
SCE.S:5B5EB4: From Brazil. Works as a guard while at language school. His grandfather came from this City.
SCE.S:5B5F80: Works near this hospital. A 2cm jointed leg sprouted from her gums. It keeps growing; it no longer fits in her mouth.
SCE.S:5B604C: Her mind changed fast instead of her body. She gained a kind of clairvoyance and healing power.
SCE.S:5B6118: Thinks of himself as rational, but is truly sadistic and twisted.
SCE.S:5B61E4: Confused, losing his judgment. Seeing the isolation-ward patients, he fears he'll end up the same.
SCE.S:5B62B0: Loves hospital gossip. Sometimes invades patients' privacy, but doesn't care.
SCE.S:5B637C: First agent sent here. The government half knew what would happen to him.
SCE.S:5B6448: Helped found the hospital. Moved to the mountains when his wife died. Fascinated by changes of body and mind.
SCE.S:5B6514: Always deeply interested in human death. Now he feels he understands the world of the dead.
SCE.S:5B65E0: Wrapped in deep grief. Chose medicine after her dear, kind uncle died of illness. All this has badly shaken her.
SCE.S:5B66AC: Wrapped in deep suffering. Couldn't adapt to the change. Longs with all his heart for his old body.
SCE.S:5B6778: His body is shriveling but his mind slowly grows. Still, he feels like a victim.
SCE.S:5B6844: In a rage she flung her visiting parents into subspace. Deep remorse led to a wrong change.
SCE.S:5B6910: Even in pain he keeps his reason; he wants to keep his dignity whatever he becomes.
SCE.S:5B69DC: He was not malicious, but he lacked kindness toward others. Dying, he saw that this caused it all.
SCE.S:5B6AA8: Hospital director, uncle of his deputy. A title, nothing more.
SCE.S:5E04F8: {6}This strange new disease seems extremely contagious.
SCE.S:5E0590: We've had so many patients these past few days. It's been rough.
SCE.S:5E0624: This is the hospital's night entrance.
SCE.S:5E06A8: {6}I've gained a strange power. When I look at a patient, I can see where the injury or illness is, just like an X-ray.
SCE.S:5E077C: {8}Fukada{2} lives alone in the northern mountains. He used to be a psychiatrist who worked at this {7}hospital{2}, I hear.
SCE.S:5E084C: {6}Don't come any closer! If you enter my field of consciousness, it will affect you.
SCE.S:5E0904: {6}Beyond here is the {8}morgue{6}. Don't go in any further!
SCE.S:5E0FCC: Outpatient reception is 7 AM to 8 PM. Please wait in Exam Room A.
SCE.S:5E1058: I'm sorry. Outpatient hours are over for today. Please refrain from visiting, too.
SCE.S:5E1138: The back ward is off limits! There are infectious patients.
SCE.S:5E1300: {6}Actually, a strange disease has broken out, and the body deforms in a very short time!
SCE.S:5E1534: You're an outpatient. Please go into the exam room.
SCE.S:5E1678: How are you feeling? Then lie down on the bed.
SCE.S:5E189C: Please relax. I'm going to give you an injection.
SCE.S:5E1980: {6}Now then, let's treat you! Close your eyes and relax.
SCE.S:5E1A6C: A relative of {8}Fukada{2}'s? Oh, not? Sorry, I jumped to conclusions. The room right across is {8}Fukada{2}'s ward.
SCE.S:5E1BEC: {6}You'd better stay away from me! I thought spreading the "change" through town was my last mission as an old man... I started with my own doctor. Then the people in the back ward. ...They all change so fast. They've overtaken me. I'm old myself, so my change is probably slow.
SCE.S:5E5D38: A doctor armed with a rifle is blocking the passage to the isolation ward! The police have set up a task force and are considering a response.
SCE.S:5E5E18: Just as the prophecy said! It's the end of the world!
SCE.S:5E5EAC: Help me! Please, don't kill me!
SCE.S:5E5F48: The hospital is overflowing with strange people. Be careful.
SCE.S:5E5FFC: {6}Somebody help! Something like spider legs is growing in my mouth!
SCE.S:5E60A0: You're from the newspaper! Listen to me. The director went into the {8}morgue{2} and hasn't come out for days. What on earth happened to him?
SCE.S:5E6238: {6}Beyond here is the {8}morgue{6}. I'd like you to keep out.
SCE.S:5E62D4: {6}I was only hospitalized for food poisoning. How did it come to this!
SCE.S:5E649C: {6}If you do nothing, I mean no harm. Here there is sadness, confusion, and endless suffering. The deputy director is in the room ahead! Their curiosity brought about this situation!
SCE.S:5E6F10: Today we're specially accepting after-hours consultations, since the whole town is in a state of emergency.
SCE.S:5E7040: The isolation ward in back is dangerous! There are unidentifiable people there, and it's in a hazardous state.
SCE.S:5E7220: Are you an outpatient? At this hour, please go to Exam Room B.
SCE.S:5E72B0: Are you an outpatient? Please go into the exam room.
SCE.S:5E7384: How are you feeling? Then lie down on the bed.
SCE.S:5E75A8: Please relax. I'm going to give you an injection.
SCE.S:5E76A4: You came. I'm so happy! I'm not officially hired yet, but with the town and the {7}hospital{2} in this state, I'm seeing patients temporarily. The {7}hospital{2} has stopped functioning, and my white coat hasn't even arrived!
SCE.S:5E7878: Watch out for the isolation ward in back! The fanatics inside the {7}hospital{2} are hiding patients! Even I, a staff member, am not allowed in. There are even armed doctors! Can you believe it? They say patients with special abilities are in the isolation ward.
SCE.S:5E7A1C: Are you all right? Patients with psychic powers! I heard from a nurse that they were secretly moving isolation ward patients to the morgue. Something must be in the morgue!
SCE.S:5E7BC4: ...What a terrible wound! I'll do what I can! Close your eyes...
SCE.S:5E7CE4: {6}I love that hospital smell. It gives me chills. But your body has no smell! Let's cut you open. Then a fragrant aroma is sure to rise!
SCE.S:5E7EDC: {8}Fukada{2}, who was in the ward across the hall, had such a high fever, yet he went home! He lives alone in the mountains! What will he do if something happens out there?
SCE.S:5E8150: {6}...I was the first agent sent by the government. You met {8}Kouda{6}? Which means the two after me have already failed. I don't have long, either. My nails grow! My nails! A centimeter every five minutes. Compared to the other deformed ones, you may think it's minor. Still, it's terrifying. Tell {8}Kouda{6}: "Use nukes!" ...Leave me alone!
SCE.S:5E8340: {6}I was sent by the government to investigate the town. My organization isn't even officially recognized. All our missions are ones where dying is expected! I used to take pride in work like that... but I've changed now! To hell with the nation! Throw everything away and join us!
SCE.S:5E8554: {6}Those far along in the change go from here to the {7}mine{6} and set out for the next dimension. This isn't a disease! It's an entirely new way of thinking, spread through words! The way of thinking itself determines the form.
SCE.S:5E87E8: Wait, I'm coming with you. As a doctor, I can't let you go alone with an injury like that!
SCE.S:5E89E4: Haven't you heard this since you were a kid? The old legend about the {7}hospital{2}! They say the morgue connects to the ancient {7}sewers{2}. I thought it was just a rumor, but this passage must be it! It must lead to the {7}mine{2}.
SCE.S:5E8CAC: {6}.....It hurts! ...My body hurts so much! ...What went wrong? Please, put me out of my misery quickly!
SCE.S:5E8E94: {6}Look how my body has changed. The direction of change can be controlled, if you have a firm image of how to change! I regret that so much confusion led to sad results. But in essence... change is wonderful! If you can't understand, I'll end your life. It's for your own good!
SCE.S:5ED4E0: The director's body was found. They say the right half of it was fading away like mist.
SCE.S:5ED598: {6}I'm starting to change too. But somehow I'm different from the others. I don't intend to abandon this world, and I want to help everyone with this power!
SCE.S:5ED89C: Outpatient reception is 7 AM to 8 PM. Please wait in the exam room.
SCE.S:5ED928: I'm sorry. Outpatient hours are over for today. Staff have dwindled because of the incident, and we can't examine everyone properly. Please refrain if your illness is minor.
SCE.S:5EDA44: {6}Now then, let's treat you! Close your eyes and relax.
SCE.S:5F1CC8: Only four doctors are left now.
SCE.S:5F1D68: I didn't know the isolation ward was in that state, even as a staff member.
SCE.S:5F1F8C: I'm sorry. At the moment we're only accepting emergencies.
SCE.S:5F20BC: There's nobody in the private room now.
SCE.S:5F64C8: {6}I'm unsure myself whether I should return to being human. This state is interesting, too.
SCE.S:5F657C: We learned the cure from an unexpected source. A doctor whose body had begun to deform took a lethal dose of a strong drug to end his life. But he didn't die, and his body returned to normal.
SCE.S:5F668C: The {7}sewers{6} linking the {7}hospital{6} and the {7}mine{6} are heavily obstructed by the {7}Psychic Association{6} people. Be careful!
SCE.S:5F69E8: Did you come here of your own will? You can probably still make it. Please come into the exam room!
SCE.S:5F6C28: {6}What will you do? Return to being an ordinary human? Or graduate from this world? If you want to become human again, enter Exam Room A here beside me.
SCE.S:5F6DF0: {6}Hello. Here we can return you to human form. Don't be afraid, come in!
SCE.S:5F6F3C: From the look of it, your change hasn't progressed very far. We've found that a certain strong drug works on people like you. I can't say there are no side effects at present... Now, lie down on the bed!
SCE.S:5F711C: By the time you leave this hospital, the change should start to show. If you feel unwell, come back quickly!
SCE.S:5F722C: Please relax. I'm going to give you an injection.
